description: Method-correctness assertions for differential-expression / regression stages — domain-correctness checks the structural validators (a non-empty DE table, an existing model artifact) passed silently in a live eval. The two errors caught: (da-15-1) a DESeq2 design that OMITTED all covariates (`~ condition` only, no sex/age/RIN), and (da-8-1) an INVERTED regression (regressed the stated outcome as a predictor). METHOD NEUTRALITY (load-bearing): every assertion asserts a property of fields the AGENT recorded about ITS OWN model (`design_formula`, `response_variable`, `primary_variable`) compared against fields the agent ALSO recorded about the data/task (`available_covariates` — the agent's honest record of the covariate columns it observed in the metadata; `stated_outcome` — the agent's record of the SME's stated outcome when the task names one). It never recommends a model, test, or which covariates to include — the agent chose those; the contract only checks that the agent's own record is internally + task-consistent (record-what-you-did, the same shape as the variant contract asserting AF∈[0,1] on the agent's own VCF). `available_covariates`/`stated_outcome` are agent-recorded in v1; hardening `available_covariates` to a pinned containerized metadata-column measurement script (so it can't be gamed by under-recording columns) is a documented follow-up (see docs/known-limitations.md). Thresholds/columns are never handed to the agent. Stages absent from a given DAG self-gate (enforcement fires only on a stage_class with a matching completed task).

assertions.description: Precondition: result.json must record the fitted model so it is auditable. An unauditable model (no recorded design_formula / response_variable) is itself a failure — the agent must state what it did. Substrings are field-name keys, not model prescriptions.

Catches da-15-1 (naked `~condition`): the agent-recorded design_formula must REFERENCE at least one of the agent-recorded available_covariates after the primary comparison variable is removed from that set — i.e. the model the agent fit must adjust for at least one of the non-primary covariate columns the agent itself observed in the metadata. PASSES when ≥1 non-primary covariate is referenced OR when none remains to adjust for. It compares the agent's own formula against the agent's own record of the data's columns; it never names which covariates to include or which model to fit (method-neutral). GATED on /available_covariates so it is SKIPPED when the agent recorded no covariate columns (nothing to adjust for, never blocks).

Catches da-8-1 (inverted regression): the agent-recorded response_variable (the model's outcome / LHS) must equal the agent-recorded stated_outcome (the SME's stated outcome for the task) after casefold+trim normalization. If the agent regressed `metabolite ~ SBP` while the task's stated outcome is SBP, response_variable=metabolite ≠ stated_outcome=SBP and this fails. It compares the agent's own model outcome against the agent's own record of the task's stated outcome; it never tells the agent which variable to regress on (method-neutral). GATED on /stated_outcome so it is SKIPPED for plain DE-by-condition with no SME-stated outcome (never blocks the common case).
